_balance: Thresholds are balance.json's (`layers`, folded in by content.mjs withBalance; tools/balance.mjs --fit re-derives 练气's from the stage quests, design.md § Pacing). `pay` scales every reward in that realm. `thresholds_were` keeps the ladders old saves were played on (state.mjs paceLayer).
_about: The ladder: tiers (this world's realms) with their steps and the progress each step asks for; `pay` scales rewards in that tier; `gate` names the chapter a tier waits for. 练气 has nine 层 above 零层 (our one exception to 凡人, story DESIGN § 道统; 零层 is `zero`): `phases` names them three by three — 一至三层 小成, 四至六层 中成, 七至九层 大成. Every realm past 练气 has no 层: its three steps are 小成, 中成, 大成 themselves (Hanli, 2026-10-09; 小成/中成/大成 is the Daoist word, 《钟吕传道集》, replacing 初期/中期/后期). `full` is the word for a step filled — 练气二层圆满, 筑基中成圆满, 筑基大成圆满 — nothing more goes in until the next step; only the realm's last step filled, its 圆满 (筑基圆满, 练气圆满), is tried for a breakthrough. 巅峰 is the spoken word for the same point (外门's 「九层巅峰」); 圆满 is the formal one, and only it stands in a table. Past 练气 each realm had three steps until 2026-10-03, nine 层 from then to 2026-10-09, and three steps again from then to 2026-11-02, each the sum of its three 层 (state.mjs v6 threeToNine, v7 nineToThree; the thresholds are the pre-10-03 ones, so the realm's whole never changed). Since 2026-11-02 (Hanli approved: 「以后可以仍然按层数算1-3=小成, 4-6=中, 7-9=大」 · 「9层用于计算, 小, 中, 大成用于显示」 · 「练气的UI不改了, 保持现在这样吧. 筑基以后再分3段UI吧」) every realm past 练气 counts nine 层 again (`steps`, one threshold each) and shows them as three 段 (`display: "stages"`): 一至三层 小成, 四至六层 中成, 七至九层 大成 (`phases`, ids `stage_ids`), read 「筑基 · 中成」 — the 层 is the bar's and the tooltip's, never a name (state.mjs stepName, stageOf). Into 四层 and 七层 a light 段 trial is thrown (`breakthrough.duan`); 九层圆满 is the realm's breakthrough as ever. 练气 is unchanged: its 层 named, no 段 trial. Each 段 asks what its step asked on three (balance.json `master.lines.gu._need_stages`: the realm's pace kept), and its 层 pay at the 段's level. A save from the three steps is carried by state v15 (state.mjs stagesCarry: step k is 段 k, the 修为 it held walked through its 层 — the same point of the 段; `thresholds_were["14"]` is the three-step ladder it was played on).

tiers._thresholds_were: 练气's thresholds a save older than each state version was played on (with 零层, by step): "9" before 2026-10-15's first re-derivation, "10" before the stage quests (2026-10-16, balance.json), "11" before the story stopped raising 层 (2026-10-16, the re-fit after), "12" the ladder of 2026-10-27 before the raise for 人间功课, which was taken back the same day (pay became a share of the layer, balance.json `_play_pay`): the same numbers, so a v12 save reads as it stood. A save from then keeps its 层 and its bar's fill (state.mjs paceLayer). "13" the ladder before the master table (2026-10-27, 数值系统 phase 2: 练气一层 470 ×1.1 a layer; v13 carries the bar as full as it stood).
tiers._zero: `zero`: this tier counts from 零层 (story DESIGN: 主角零层入门; 古四's one night of 小周天 → 一层, Hanli 2026-10-15). steps[0] is 零层, its threshold 0: entered with no 修为 and no bar, nothing fills it, and only a story's `rise` (wm-zhoutian's 小周天) leaves it. Its layer N is step N (state.mjs layerNo/stepOfLayer), so a `rise` or a cap's `layer` names the 层 as the book does. Before 2026-10-15 step 0 was 一层 (state.mjs v8 zeroLayer carries the save).

tiers._thresholds_were: 筑基's (and every realm's above it, each its own) thresholds a save older than state v13 was played on (2026-10-27, 数值系统 phase 2: the master table's numbers; state.mjs paceLayer).

_lines: Each line its own 修为 and ladder (Hanli 2026-10-27, story 宇宙.md § 三条线，各自一套修为与境界; design.md § 境界 in the game): 古, 今 and 未来 don't advance together, so a line other than the book's own (`tiers`, 古) has its ladder here — its `hero` (people.json: the name the top bar shows on that line's scenes), its nine realms in `tiers` (ids never shared with another line's, so balance.json `layers` and `play_pay.hours` key them as they key 古's). Its first realm has nine 层 from 一层 (no 零层: no story rise lifts it), each realm above three steps (小成 · 中成 · 大成), named with `phases` and `full` as 古's. No caps, no gates, no breakthrough throw yet: at a realm's top the bar fills and waits. The save keeps each line's place in `lines.<line>` (state.mjs lineStart; rules/lines.mjs).

jin._about: 今 (沈芒's line): the social ladder — 新生 初来乍到 · 立身 站住脚 · 成器 一门本事 · 立业 自己一摊事 · 通达 读得懂人 · 担当 替人扛事 · 有容 容得下人 · 知命 不慌 · 从心 不逾矩 (宇宙.md). Thresholds are balance.json's (`master.lines.jin`).

_full: `full`: appended to a step's name when its progress is full (state.mjs fullName; zh 筑基中成圆满, en 'Foundation Establishment · Middle Attainment, Consummation'). The realm's last step filled reads short, realm + word (peakName: 筑基圆满, 练气圆满) — a breakthrough's `from`. Was 大圆满 until 2026-10-09: a Tibetan Buddhist term; 圆满 alone is the Daoist one.
_layers_were: `layers_were`: each realm's nine 层 thresholds as they stood 2026-10-03 → 2026-10-09, kept only so a save made then is carried into the three steps exactly (state.mjs nineToThree): 层 1–3 → 小成, 4–6 → 中成, 7–9 → 大成, the 修为 of the 层 passed in that step added to what it held.
_caps: The cap per 回 (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 「游戏里修炼有个上限吧? 和故事对齐」; rules/cap.mjs): `hui` names, for each 古 回, the highest step (a 层 of 练气, a 成 above it) the player's own work reaches there (`tier`, `layer` as the book names it: a 层 of 练气 from 零层 (0), a 层 above it from 1 — 筑基三层 is 3; a 成 from 1 until 2026-11-02) and, when the 回's scenes carry him further, how far its story goes (`story`; else the same). Filled to the cap, fights pay 灵石 and the rest counts on past the mark (`say` by the full bar — the way on is the story, never more sitting (Hanli 11-03): the page's 「走剧情破境 ›」 opens the 事 book at it; `pill` when a 修为 pill would do nothing); a scene's rise or breakthrough past `story` is refused (`refuse`). A 回 with none takes the one before it in the book (a 今 interlude, its 古); after 卷一 the save waits in 古九's chapter, so it stays 筑基小成 until 卷二 is written and given its caps; a chapter with no 回 (the old spine) has none — its realm gate rules it. A save already past its cap is never pulled down: it fills its own step and waits for the story. From the book (story/jiuding-lu/OUTLINE.md 境界线, DESIGN § 六·八 定例): 古三 入门 at 零层 (`layer` 0: nothing grinds 零层); 古四 一层 by the 小周天 (wm-zhoutian's rise), held there through 九月 (褚先生's roll call: 小满 一层), 十月廿五 二层 (lifted at 古四's close, wm-diyilu — the 回's `story`); 古五 二层 → 四层 by 息壤 (wm-xirang); 古六 四层 (大比 on 四层); 古七 (h11) 四层 until the years carry him to 七层 (09-year `futian`); 古八 (h09) 七层, the years after to 九层圆满 (09-dabi) and the cliff to 筑基 (09-cliff); 古九 (h10) 筑基小成 — the first step of 筑基 (古七 split in two, Hanli 2026-10-07); since 2026-11-02 筑基 counts nine 层 and 小成 is 一至三层, so h09's `story` and h10 name `layer` 3 (筑基三层: the whole of 小成).

say.zh: 这一回的修为到顶了。往下走剧情，到了下一回才破得了境；多出来的都在丹田里攒着，一分不丢。
say.en: Cultivation has reached this chapter's top. Follow the story on — the next chapter opens the way through; what you gain past it gathers below the navel, not a breath lost.

refuse.zh: 鼎气不肯近身。火候未到——往下走剧情，到了时候，它自己会来。
refuse.en: The cauldron's breath will not come near. The fire is not ready — follow the story on, and when its time comes, it will come to you.

pill.zh: 这一回的修为到顶了，服下也不长；往下走剧情，破了境再服。
pill.en: Cultivation is at this chapter's top; it would do nothing now. Follow the story on, and take it once you break through.

caps._stage: 阶段任务 (Hanli, 2026-10-15; rules/gates.mjs): `gates` in a 回 are the ways on that wait on 圆满 of a layer — `{layer, scene, exits}`, the 层 as the book names it (`tier` the first unless said). Refused with `stage.refuse` until the realm stands there full or past it; the 事 book shows it, 下一步 and Ling point to the work that raises 修为. A gate stands only where he can walk away to earn it — never inside a key beat's lock, nor inside a sealed instance unless its own room hosts practice boards to earn it with (the lint holds it; 2026-10-31): 古四: the 柴房 night on 一层圆满; past it 二层 is his to sit into (h05's cap is 二层 since 2026-10-27 — the book has him sit into 二层 on 十月廿五 (wm-yan) and stand at 二层巅峰 the night before the 秘境 (wm-baoming); a cap of 一层 kept the bar a layer under the story). 古五: the 石室 on 三层圆满 (wm-kaikai); the 秘境's door (二层圆满) and the 石室's 四层圆满 (wm-xiqi) dropped 2026-11-03 for share holds (see `_h07`). 古六: the 大比's eve on 三层圆满 (2026-10-27, doc/gates-2026-10-27.md 古六 (b); again since 2026-11-03): a catch-up: a save that came through the 石室 short steps into 四层 there; a fresh one stands at 四层 already, its bar held to shares across 古六 (0.45 until wm-dabi, 0.6 until wm-jiejing, 0.8 until 09-snow, and in 古七 0.8 until 09-jiuge) so 圆满 lands at 09-jiuge, the scene before 定风 (2026-11-10, Hanli: 「最好做成满了后的下一场剧情是突破」 · 「三处按挪放开点改」; was 09-snow, two scenes before). From 2026-10-31 to 11-03 it asked 四层圆满 — dead for a save that came through the 石室 (already full there) and, for one that came through short, 四层圆满 at the eve and some 25 scenes held full to 定风 (Hanli 11-03: 「第4层圆满后, 走了很多剧情也没破镜, 像卡住了一样」). 古七: each rise on the layer below it full — 定风 (09-furnace, 「那天早上……他过了五层」) the one gate on 五层; 09-year's catch-up gate (四层圆满 again, at 伏天) dropped 2026-11-03: it kept 五层 shut two scenes past the morning the book has him through it. 五层 stops at 0.7 until 09-fangshi, 六层 at 0.7 until 09-nianyao. Pacing (Hanli 11-03: 圆满 lands just before the book's breakthrough, not many scenes early): tests/pacing.test.mjs walks the model players and a grinder at his rate (tools/balance.mjs trace) and holds every run of 古 scenes held full to 3 — 卷一's end alone excepted. 古八: a stage quest a year since 2026-10-28 (doc/gates-2026-10-27.md 古八 (a + c)) — 年六 on 七层圆满 (09-shenshi/winter, 「那年冬天，他过了八层」), 年七 on 八层圆满 before the 腊月 (09-dingfeng/laba, 「那年腊月之前，他九层了」; the 腊八 final is 09-laba's), 九层圆满 at 瞿老's door (09-qulao/listen since 2026-11-03, the 筑基 beat's entry; was 09-yanceng/ruqiu, which left 九层 full four scenes before the cliff), 九层 held at 0.7 until he stands there, the 九层 lump moved to 09-yanceng's way on into it (the cliff's breakthrough then the player's own throw) — was 腊八 and 入秋 on one scene, 09-dabi. 古九 has none. No story rise (Hanli, 2026-10-16: 「要让玩家去刷经验/修为等. 不要直接跳层」): every rise the book had is a gate here — or, where it stood inside a locked beat (第一路's 二层, 息壤's 四层), the next gate asks that layer and more; the one rise left is 入门 (零层 → 一层, the 小周天: 零层 holds no 修为, so nothing is skipped). A stage quest met is handed in (交差) and pays balance.json `pay.stage`, once (rules/gates.mjs).
caps._h07: 2026-11-03 (Hanli: 「可以, 两件一起做」 — 圆满 just before the book's breakthrough, the 层 still the book's): the 石室 has 小满 break through to 四层 (「第二天晌午，他冲开了第四层」) and the book has 五层 only at 定风, so wm-kaikai's way on (`sit`) waits on 三层圆满 — earned in the 石室 itself (its hosted 主力 boards, places mijing-shishi; the world outside is frozen), its own `say` — and wm-xiqi asks nothing (its 四层圆满 gate and the 760 lump on wm-kaikai's way on were cut: they filled 四层 here, ~30 scenes before 定风). 「再吸半天，就五层了」 is 小满's own reach, which 银月 stops. Share holds (`holds` with `share`, rules/cap.mjs shareMark): the bar on a layer stops at that share until the story reaches the scene — the rest waits in the 丹田 (`banked`, 「一分不丢」; a fight's or a board's past it is 灵石, as at 圆满) — and the cap's own words and 「走剧情破境 ›」 say why. 二层 stops at 0.6 until wm-yan and 0.85 (巅峰, wm-baoming) until wm-mingpai (the scene before the 石室's night, since 2026-11-10; was wm-tama, two before), full only by wm-kaikai, where 三层 opens (the full hold `{layer 2, until wm-kaikai}` keeps him at 二层 through the rooms); 四层 at 0.3 until 古六. 古六's eve (wm-qianye) asks 三层圆满, a catch-up for a save that came through the 石室 before its gates. Before: 2026-10-31 — 10-28's 「故事里是4层圆满」 put the 秘境's door on 二层圆满 and the 石室 on 三层 then 四层圆满.

refuse.zh: 阶段任务：先修炼到{step}。功课、秘境、斗法，都长修为。
refuse.en: Stage quest: first cultivate to {step}. Practice, the secret realm and fights all raise cultivation.

stage._part: A gate that asks a share of its layer (`share` on a gate, rules/gates.mjs gateName; Hanli 2026-11-10: 「可以是剧情-游戏-剧情-游戏-剧情-游戏到圆满-剧情突破」 · 「可以，按 2 天来」): named as the layer at that many tenths — 练气五层四成, the 成 a tenth as the cultivators count it. Met, it opens: no 交差, no `pay.stage` (nothing new paid, no back pay to an older save). `tenths` the digit by tenths. The layer's last gate asks 圆满.

h05._gates: The 柴房 night on 一层圆满, and before it two steps of 一层 (shares, 2026-11-10 — a proposal for Hanli: tools/balance.mjs's typical player waited 3.4 days at the 柴房 in one block; 点卯 and the 执事房 each stop him a day or so first): 点卯's way on at 四成, the 执事房's way to the patrol at 七成. Not at the 青石 (inside 入门's lock: nowhere to earn it) nor at the 药园's way to the 柴房 (the 柴房's own gate is held at that door, rules/gates.mjs entryGate, so a share there would only lengthen the one stop).

say.zh: 阶段任务：先修炼到{step}。石室里的灵气还厚着——就在石室里吸。
say.en: Stage quest: first cultivate to {step}. The qi in the stone chamber still lies thick — draw it in right here.

h11._gates: 古七's layers as the book's rises come (定风 五层, 沂水 六层, 伏天 七层), and since 2026-11-10 (a proposal for Hanli) 五层 and 六层 each in three stretches, not one block of play after the layer's story: 五层 四成 at the 丹房's way on, 六成 at 这一年's 伏天; 六层 三成 at 鯥's spring, 七成 at 碾药's way on (tools/balance.mjs typical: 2.4 → ≤ 1.1 days a stop at 五层, 4.5 → ≤ 1.9 at 六层).

_treasure: The nine 重 of a 本命法宝, grown by 温养 and by what a fight leaves — design.md § 斗法.
_breakthrough: 渡劫 is one throw that can fail (Hanli, 2026-09-28: 红检, you pick). The chance starts at `base` for the realm it opens and each factor adds to it, then it is held between `floor` and `cap`. `pill`: the realm's breakthrough pill carried in the bag, worth more the more 转 it has (eaten only by a throw that lands — a failed one keeps it, as the card promises: 境界与所藏不失). `body`: 伤势 is 体力 since 2026-09-24 — at least `share` of the pool is `whole`, under it `hurt`. `seclusion`: out of a 闭关 of at least its min_hours within `hours`. `her`: 银月 at the player's side, plus `per_gift` for each gift the cauldrons gave her. `element`: the realm's 五行; a root of it is `match`, a root that feeds it (相生) is `feeds`. A failure wounds (`fail.wound`, a share of the 体力 pool), takes `fail.progress` of the peak step's 修为 and shuts the cauldron for `fail.cooldown_hours` real hours; the realm, the save and every thing held — the pill too — are never lost; under the peak after a failure, 闭关 brings the 修为 back (the refusal says so). Under `low` a success is marked 逆天.

pill._items: A list is reached for in order: the furnace's 九转 first, the sect's 一转 after (古八 — the 筑基 half of the old 古七, split 2026-10-07: he eats the 九转; the 官丹 he won at the year-five 大比 stays sealed in the 储物袋, unused). A pill's bonus is its own `bonus_of`, else by its 转 (`by_zhuan`, items.json `zhuan`: the 官丹 is 一转下品, +25; the furnace's 九转 +80, near-certain), else `bonus`. 鼎苔 (古五) is the last reached for: eaten raw it steadies the throw a little (bonus_of 10).

breakthrough._duan: The 段 trial (Hanli approved 2026-11-02, the nine-层 change): in a realm shown in 段 (`display: "stages"`) the step into 四层 and into 七层 — 小成 → 中成, 中成 → 大成 — is a light throw, no pill: `base` plus the realm throw's `body`, `seclusion`, `her` and `element` factors (`factors`), held between `floor` and `cap`. It is thrown where the 修为 carries him over the 段's last 层 (state.mjs addProgress's door, rules/breakthrough.mjs duanPass), seeded as the realm throw (the save, the realm, the 段, the try). A failure costs nothing but the hour: the 层 stays full, the 修为 keeps counting past its mark, and the trial waits `cooldown_hours` before the next pay throws again. 九层圆满 into the next realm is the realm throw above, unchanged; 练气 has none.
breakthrough._odds: 筑基 follows the book (story DESIGN § 定例 · 沉鼎观的数; 2026-10-03): without a pill about one in ten gets through (base 10), the sect's one 一转 lifts it to a few in ten, a 九转 makes it near-certain. `floor` 5: a throw is never hopeless.
